subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI messages can reach shared context but still not appear in Open WebUI visible chat history

question: Should OpenClaw core own syncing external Control UI turns into Open WebUI's visible history store, and if yes through which supported boundary?
rationale: The remaining work is not a mechanical bug fix because it requires choosing whether OpenClaw may write to third-party Open WebUI persistence, how operators opt in, what schema/API compatibility is supported, and whether old missing turns are repaired.

options.title: Approve opt-in sync
options.body: Add an explicit operator-enabled sync path with Open WebUI schema/API version handling, docs, new-turn tests, and live Open WebUI plus Control UI proof.

options.title: Document unsupported co-editing
options.body: Keep OpenClaw transcript/model context as the owned source and document that Control UI sends do not update Open WebUI visible history.

options.title: Route to plugin or integration seam
options.body: Keep core unchanged unless a plugin/API extension is needed to let a separate Open WebUI integration own the visible-history mirror safely.

recommendation.title: Approve opt-in sync
recommendation.body: Add an explicit operator-enabled sync path with Open WebUI schema/API version handling, docs, new-turn tests, and live Open WebUI plus Control UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Gateway chat persistence boundary and recent path history point to steipete as the best available routing owner for the product/ownership decision.
